plan.title: Order Activity Records a Rejected Bid

steps.note: Create a test event for the buyer-side rejection flow.
Use an RFQ stage because the case concerns a vendor bid.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add one line item so the vendor can submit a bid.
Invite one QA vendor to submit the test bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the invited QA vendor submit a bid to create a bid that can be rejected.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted before attempting rejection.

args.need: as the buyer, reject the vendor's submitted bid on this test event and return to the event's stage page
